summary: On the Main Deck, Mouse's body thrashes against its harness, coughing blood from his mouth in one final spasm, then lies perfectly still. The flatline ALARM softly cries out from the life MONITOR, marking his death. (Scenes 98 and 99 are omitted.)

what_changes.before: Thrashing against his harness, alive and spasming in his final moments.
what_changes.evidence: Mouse's body thrashes against its harness, blood coughing from his mouth in one final spasm, then lying perfectly still.

event_hint.one_line: Mouse dies on the Main Deck as the flatline alarm sounds.
